profile_text.body:
SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft, according to its own site. The company says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered at Starbase, Texas, and trades under the ticker SPCX. Its SEC central index key is 0001181412. No AI products are tracked for it, and no MCP servers are listed.

No individual lawsuits are listed for the company. Its law exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 103.
